pattern.description: The Embed code card collapses: its text blurs out while the card shrinks into a compact rounded widget, the large orb shrinks into the widget's avatar slot, a dot grows into the black Start a call pill, and the labels fade in.
pattern.why_premium: One shape continuously becomes the next component, so the viewer sees the embed snippet turn into the live widget it produces; cause and effect is shown without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.embed-content', {opacity: 0, filter: 'blur(6px)', duration: 0.2}); tl.to('.card', {width: 396, height: 145, borderRadius: 40, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, '<'); tl.to('.orb', {scale: 0.22, x: 470, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, '<'); tl.fromTo('.call-pill', {width: 24, height: 24}, {width: 228, height: 55, duration: 0.35, ease: 'back.out(1.2)'}, '-=0.25'); tl.fromTo('.widget-label, .call-pill > *', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.05}, '-=0.1');
build_hint.remotion: Shared progress p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) drives card width/height/radius, orb scale/translateX via interpolate(p, ...). Pill size from spring({frame: frame-10, fps, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 200}}); labels opacity interpolate(frame, [14,20], [0,1]).

notes: Camera verdict is none; the raw scale 0.40 reflects the card shrinking inside the frame, not a pull-out. The cursor and Copied! tooltip from the start frames exit and are not in the end frame. No SFX candidates.
